steps.name: reject-stale-research-before-generation
steps.summary: The shared daily pipeline rejects research fetched more than 24 hours ago, in the future, or with invalid timestamps before usage, generation, slug lookup, or persistence. Boundary/time-zone and no-side-effect tests passed: focused 21/21, unit 156 passed/12 DB skips, isolated PostgreSQL integration 13/13, lint, typecheck and build. No real provider, collector, OCI or timer was activated.
